text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It appears I have to take it easy for a
while.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course. I know that's what I
should do,
but...
choice_data_list: Let's focus on getting you fully healed.
Injuries come with the territory! I'll get used to this in no time!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I simply have so much... free time. You can't expect me to just stay in bed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I hate not having anything to do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to resume training as soon as
possible, I
firmly put King Halo on
temporary bed rest.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want to get used to it, dummy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, I know in my head that I have no
choice but
to accept my blunder.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I simply need to focus on sorting through
these
unfamiliar feelings and heal up...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grrrgh! But why do I still feel so
frustrated?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fussing about things that can't be
changed is a
waste of time! Pull yourself
together, King!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although King Halo says she needs to
accept her
mistakes, it appears to be
easier said than done.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But still, this could also be a good
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's simply one of the hurdles that
first-rate
Umamusume must overcome.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This experience serves to make me
stronger. The
unknown may be
frightening, but once I know it,
it will
become common place.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. We'll overcome every
obstacle
in our way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Every one brings me that much closer to
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter what difficulties cause her to
stumble,
King Halo will always strive to
stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This injury will only serve to make her
even
stronger.
